note: The exact build-tool archives the workflows download. Every entry is verified against these bytes BEFORE the archive is unzipped or handed to a tool. No digest here is invented. The sha1 is the one Google's own repository manifest publisheth; the sha256 was measured on the archive and agreed with that manifest's size. A downloaded blob that is not these bytes is a supply-chain substitution and is refused by name.

extracted.digest_rule: sha256 over the sorted 'relpath\0bytes\0sha256(blob)\n' of every regular file under the archive's cmdline-tools/ root (symlinks refused); the tree is digested by CONTENT so a preexisting $ANDROID_HOME/cmdline-tools/latest that is not these bytes is refused rather than trusted

provenance.sha1_source: the <checksum> Google's repository2-1.xml declares for commandlinetools-mac-11076708_latest.zip (cmdline-tools;12.0, host os macosx)
provenance.sha256_source: measured on a fresh download of the URL above; the measured size (153607488) equals the size repository2-1.xml declares for this archive, so the measured bytes are the declared bytes
provenance.consumed_by: the ios job's 'provision the Android command-line SDK' step, which unzippeth this archive into $ANDROID_HOME/cmdline-tools/latest
